title: Ride Limit
story: A travel card allows at most a given number of rides, and rides go one way along the listed connections. How many stations can be reached from the start using at most that many rides? The start counts; with 0 rides it is the only one.

notes: Stations are numbered 0 to n-1, and start is a real station.

hints: Explore from the start in rings: first the stations one ride away, then two rides, and so on.
A queue and a NEW LIST of rides per station, starting at -1, give each station its fewest rides.
Do not ride on from a station that is already at the limit, then count the stations that were reached.
edgeCases: a limit smaller than the farthest station
